meta.name: The Fixers
meta.description: A washed-up gangster reluctantly teams up with an arrogant political heir to become "fixers", cleaning up dangerous secrets for both sides of the law.

videos.title: The Swamp Eel
videos.overview: When his wife loses money in a crypto scam, ex-gangster Felix Chiang looks for a way to make ends meet. Legislator Chao asks Ching He Temple for help.

videos.title: Night and Day
videos.overview: Facing a health crisis and mounting debt, Felix takes a lucrative job from the Ching He Temple. But it comes with a reluctant partner — Louis Hsueh.

videos.title: Dog Eat Dog
videos.overview: Felix and Louis investigate who leaked Sheng's secret videos, but Prosecutor Yen's hidden agenda threatens to derail their mission.

videos.title: The Fix
videos.overview: Ching He Temple takes a case for the San He Association after boss Lin's disappearance sparks infighting, but Felix refuses to get involved.

videos.title: One Short
videos.overview: Felix confronts someone from his past he can't forgive. Mina tasks Louis with tracking down a former fixer she once knew.

videos.title: Diamond Ice
videos.overview: With scammer Hung helping them, Felix, Louis and Mina make their play to get close to William. Thackeray conspires to keep the Hsueh family in check.

videos.title: Tien-bu-la
videos.overview: Mina and Louis discover the location where Gerald may be hiding, but they're not alone on their journey. Madam Fan sends Sir Hong an ominous warning.

videos.title: Fake, Forsaken, Fraud
videos.overview: As her allegiances fray, Mina seeks vengeance for her loved ones. A family health crisis pushes Louis to confront Tristan over the Hsuehs' secrets.
